# Outlier

> Mac-native local AI runtime with a custom paged Mixture-of-
> Experts inference engine. Runs models up to
> Qwen3.5-397B-A17B on 64GB Apple Silicon Macs by streaming
> expert weights off SSD (about 2 tokens a second). Offline, no API tokens, no usage caps.
> Includes an agent loop (plan / act / verify /
> recover), MCP connectors, Projects, coding as a mode of the
> Core tier, and six model tiers from 4B to 397B.

## Pricing
- Requirements: M1 or newer · macOS 15+ (free update)
- Free: Nano 4B + Lite 9B, no account, no token bill
- Pro: unlocked by a one-time purchase, not a subscription - all six tiers including Plus 397B, Marathon mode, Computer use, Deep Research, context up to 128K tokens (Free: 8K). $29 once, activates on up to 3 Macs, 30-day money-back guarantee.
- Outlier Lifetime Licence. Black Friday sale: $16.99 once, 31% off our November price of $24.50, through December 2. Then $29. The sale lasts until 2026-12-03 07:59 UTC, the end of 2 December US Pacific; from 3 December $29. The Buy button applies the discount automatically. Everything Pro includes for the lifetime of the Outlier product, including future model releases. If Outlier is ever sunset, licence holders get 90 days' notice and a final release.

## Who makes Outlier
Outlier is made by Kerr & Company (https://kerrandcompanyholdings.com/), one person in Grand Rapids, Michigan, who also makes Crisp Video (offline video restore for Mac) and Docket SEO (website audits).
